memories.author: D03
memories.text:
70-year-old man presents with fatigue and tingling in feet.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: He reports progressive tiredness over 2 months and numbness in both feet.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 70 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 24.8 (overweight). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal; sensation decreased to light touch over distal toes.
IMPRESSION: Clinical picture suggestive of vitamin B12 deficiency. Order serum B12, MCV and haemoglobin.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Advise balanced diet rich in animal proteins and daily walk. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 150 pg/mL (ref 200-900). MCV: 105 fL (ref 80-100). Haemoglobin: 11.2 g/dL (ref 13-17).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Since starting the B12 tablets my energy is better, but I still feel a slight tingling in my toes at night.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
70-year-old man returns for follow-up of vitamin B12 deficiency.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports improved fatigue, persistent mild toe tingling.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 70 kg, BMI 24.8 (overweight). Neurological exam shows mild distal proprioceptive loss.
IMPRESSION: Partial response to B12 replacement; continue current dose.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Advise maintain weight, regular exercise. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 340 pg/mL (ref 200-900). MCV: 98 fL (ref 80-100). Haemoglobin: 12.8 g/dL (ref 13-17).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
70-year-old man for routine review; autumn influenza vaccine due.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Feels well, no new symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/80 mmHg, weight 70 kg, BMI 24.8 (overweight). Lungs clear, heart regular.
IMPRESSION: Vitamin B12 deficiency stable on treatment. Annual fasting lipids and glucose ordered.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD. Give inactivated influenza vaccine today (02-Oct-2025). Advise diet low in saturated fats, walk 30 mins daily. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting blood sugar: 92 mg/dL (ref 70-100). Lipid profile: Total cholesterol 185 mg/dL (<200), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), LDL 102 mg/dL (<130), Triglycerides 138 mg/dL (<150).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past week I’ve noticed numbness spreading to the soles of my feet and occasional mild imbalance when walking.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
70-year-old man reports worsening foot numbness and mild imbalance.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Progressive numbness soles, slight unsteadiness.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 71 kg, BMI 25.2 (obese). Sensation reduced to vibration over ankles.
IMPRESSION: Possible B12 insufficiency despite therapy; consider dose increase.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase methylcobalamin to 2000 mcg OD. Reinforce diet, weight control. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Methylcobalamin 2000 mcg OD for 2 months, then reassess.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 22-Apr-2026 at 10:30 AM with Dr Priya Natarajan (D03) for follow‑up of vitamin B12 deficiency.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
70-year-old man returns for scheduled follow‑up.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Reports numbness improved, no imbalance.
EXAMINATION: BP 135/82 mmHg, weight 70 kg, BMI 24.8 (overweight). Foot sensation normal to monofilament.
IMPRESSION: Good response to increased B12 dose; plan to taper to maintenance.
ARRANGEMENTS: Reduce methylcobalamin to 1500 mcg OD. Continue lifestyle advice. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum vitamin B12: 420 pg/mL (ref 200-900). MCV: 92 fL (ref 80-100). Haemoglobin: 13.5 g/dL (ref 13-17).
